description: Diff two ingested inventory commits (fromSha to toSha): added/removed nodes and edges. Returns { added, removed, changed }. Requires inventory_v2. Read-only. Use before merging a PR that touches inventory.yaml to see what changed; use get_inventory for the current snapshot.

fromSha.description: Older commit SHA (the baseline to diff from)

projectId.description: Project UUID — defaults to configured project (`project_id` is accepted too.)

toSha.description: Newer commit SHA (the candidate to diff to)

name: diff_inventory
title: Inventory diff
